blocks.text: Micro-airjet pressure that opens the skin — not pierces it
blocks.html: Micro-airjet pressure that opens the skin — not pierces it

The skin’s outer barrier blocks roughly 97% of what is applied to its surface. Medi-Jet bypasses this barrier using controlled micro-airjet technology: a pressurised stream that momentarily opens micro-pathways in the epidermis, allowing the active cocktail to penetrate directly to the dermis — the layer where collagen, elastin, and skin density are built and maintained.
Double cleanse to remove surface impurities and prepare the skin for optimal absorption.
A mild enzymatic exfoliant clears the uppermost skin layer, allowing the airjet to work without obstruction.
Manual massage stimulates circulation and prepares the tissue before infusion.
The micro-airjet delivers your chosen active cocktail past the epidermis to the dermis — the treatment’s core mechanism.
A sealing mask locks in the infused actives and begins the post-treatment calming and repair phase.

The protocol follows a precise sequence: preparation, delivery, and consolidation. You leave with actives already working at cellular depth — not sitting on the surface waiting to be absorbed.

Choose your formulation before the session — Radiance or Rejuvenate — and the Medi-Jet protocol is built around it from step one.

blocks.text: Why most actives never reach where they need to go
blocks.html: Why most actives never reach where they need to go

The epidermis is an effective barrier — it keeps the environment out, and it keeps most of what you apply on the surface. Active ingredients in skincare, however well formulated, rarely cross the epidermal barrier in meaningful concentrations. The dermis — where collagen and elastin are produced, where skin density is regulated — stays largely untreated.
Active ingredients sit on the skin surface. The skin barrier blocks most of what is applied — only a fraction reaches below the epidermis.
Micro-airjet opens pathways without breaking the skin. Actives reach the dermis evenly — while activating the skin’s own renewal response.
Needles bypass the barrier and deliver actives directly to the dermis. Results can be strong, but so are the risks: discomfort, bruising, and recovery time.

Medi-Jet occupies the space between these two approaches — the depth of an injection, without the trauma. Actives reach the dermis intact, in controlled concentration, and the skin’s natural renewal processes are engaged alongside the infusion.

blocks.text: Is the Medi-Jet treatment painful, and what can I expect during the session?
blocks.html: Is the Medi-Jet treatment painful, and what can I expect during the session?

Medi-Jet is comfortable throughout. The airjet device produces a light, controlled pressure as it moves across the skin — most clients describe a mild tingling at most. There is no breaking of the skin, no injection sensation, and no numbing required. The 90-minute session runs as a complete protocol — cleanse, enzyme peel, massage, infusion, and mask — with each stage building on the last. You can return to your normal routine immediately after.

blocks.text: How do I choose between the Radiance and Rejuvenate formulations?
blocks.html: How do I choose between the Radiance and Rejuvenate formulations?

The choice comes down to your primary skin concern. Radiance is built for pigmentation, uneven skin tone, dullness, and dark spots — its cocktail centres on brightening actives and melanin regulation. Rejuvenate addresses fine lines, loss of firmness, and skin that has lost density over time — its cocktail contains Growth Factors, Copper Tripeptide, and a full cellular nutrition complex. If your concerns span both categories, discuss with your therapist before the session — they will guide you to the formulation that addresses your most pressing concern, and note the secondary one for a follow-up course.

blocks.text: How many sessions do I need, and when will I see results?
blocks.html: How many sessions do I need, and when will I see results?

Many clients notice a visible improvement in hydration, luminosity, and skin tone immediately after the first session — this is the acute effect of dermis-level hydration. For concerns such as pigmentation, fine lines, or firmness, the deeper structural changes build over a course of treatments. A course of four to six sessions, spaced two to four weeks apart, is typically recommended for sustained results. Your therapist will advise a maintenance frequency once the initial course is complete, based on how your skin responds.
